home.copy.title: Your first post (copy mode)
home.copy.s1: 1. Draft: open Build, pick a day, press Generate draft.
home.copy.s2: 2. Gate: the fact and style gate checks the draft.
home.copy.s4: 4. Paste it on LinkedIn yourself, then press Post there.
home.copy.noapp: No LinkedIn developer app and no token are needed for this. Profile-Wrap never touches your LinkedIn account in copy mode.
home.copy.link_connect: Connect LinkedIn (optional, only for API posting)
copy.title: Copy for LinkedIn
copy.intro: The draft passed the gate. Copy it, open LinkedIn, press Start a post and paste.
copy.caption: Copy post text
copy.failed: The browser blocked the clipboard. Select the text and copy it by hand.
copy.blocked: The gate did not pass, so nothing is offered to copy. Fix the findings above first.
copy.after: On LinkedIn press Start a post, paste, attach any media, then press Post. Post the first comment yourself too.
copy.refused.slug: That is not a valid draft name.
copy.refused.nodraft: There is no draft named {slug}. Make one first (Build screen, or the setup skill).
copy.refused.unreadable: The draft could not be read: {detail}
copy.refused.status: This draft is marked {status}, so it is not offered again.
copy.refused.empty: The draft has no caption yet. Write it first.
copy.refused.problem: The draft cannot be posted as it is: {detail}
copy.refused.gate: The gate did not pass ({count} failing). Fix it first: {first}
copy.refused.nopart: The draft has nothing for that part (no first comment or alt text).
copy.cli.copied: Copied to the clipboard. On LinkedIn press Start a post, paste, then press Post.
copy.cli.noclip: No clipboard tool was found on this machine. The text is printed below; copy it by hand.
init.next.copy: Posting mode is copy: draft, run the gate, run 'profile-wrap copy <draft>' and paste on LinkedIn by hand. No LinkedIn developer app is needed. Optional later: 'profile-wrap auth connect'.
connect.title: Connect LinkedIn
connect.intro: Optional. Do this only if you want Profile-Wrap to post for you through LinkedIn's official API, using your own free developer app. It takes about 15 minutes the first time.
connect.nopassword: Profile-Wrap never asks for your LinkedIn password. You sign in on LinkedIn's own page, and the app only receives a token.
connect.copy_first: Copy mode keeps working without any of this.
connect.saved: Saved on this computer, in your Profile-Wrap config folder.
connect.finish_cli: Done. Posting stays in copy mode until you opt in on the Connect LinkedIn screen in the app, or answer y next time.
step.app.title: Create your developer app
step.app.how: In the LinkedIn Developer Portal choose Create app. Give it a name only you will recognise. When the form asks for a LinkedIn Page, pick one you manage or create a small one. Then open the Auth tab and keep the Client ID and the Primary Client Secret ready.
step.products.title: Add the two products
step.products.how: On the app's Products tab add both products below. Do not apply for the Community Management API; you do not need it.
step.redirect.title: Set the redirect URL
step.redirect.how: On the Auth tab, under Authorized redirect URLs, add exactly this address:
step.credentials.title: Save the client ID and secret
step.credentials.how: Paste the Client ID and the Client Secret from the Auth tab. They are stored on this computer only, in your Profile-Wrap config folder with user-only permissions, never in your workspace and never shown again.
step.signin.title: Sign in
step.signin.how: Press Sign in. LinkedIn's own page opens in your browser; press Allow there. If the page does not open, use the link shown.
res.app.todo: No client ID yet. Create the app, then paste its Client ID in step 4.
res.products.done: The sign-in came back with all the permissions needed.
res.products.unverified: This can only be checked at sign-in. If sign-in ends with a permissions error, a product is missing.
res.products.missing_scope: The sign-in is missing these permissions: {missing}. Add the matching product on the Products tab, then sign in again.
res.products.config_scopes: Your config asks for too few scopes (missing: {missing}). Fix linkedin.scopes in config/profile-wrap.json.
res.redirect.done: The address is valid and port {port} is free: {uri}
res.redirect.scheme: The redirect URL must start with http:// (LinkedIn allows that for localhost). Fix linkedin.redirect_uri.
res.redirect.host: The redirect host must be localhost or 127.0.0.1, not {host}. Fix linkedin.redirect_uri.
res.redirect.port: The redirect URL needs a port, for example http://localhost:8765/callback.
res.redirect.path: The redirect URL needs a path after the port, for example /callback.
res.redirect.busy: Port {port} is busy. Close the program that uses it, or change linkedin.redirect_uri to another port and add the same address in the portal.
res.creds.done: Client ID and secret are saved.
res.creds.todo: Paste the Client ID and the Client Secret.
res.creds.id_format: The Client ID should be letters and digits only, 8 to 40 characters, with no spaces. Copy it again from the Auth tab.
res.creds.secret_format: The Client Secret should be 8 to 128 characters with no spaces. Copy the Primary Client Secret again.
res.creds.password_refused: Profile-Wrap never accepts a LinkedIn password. Send only the Client ID and the Client Secret.
res.signin.blocked: Save the Client ID and Secret first (step 4).
res.signin.done: Signed in as {name}. The sign-in has {days} days left.
res.signin.soon: The sign-in ends in {days} days. Sign in again soon.
res.signin.expired: The sign-in has expired. Sign in again.
res.signin.waiting: Waiting for LinkedIn. Press Allow in the browser tab. This stops after {seconds} seconds.
res.signin.busy: A sign-in is already waiting for LinkedIn.
res.signin.error.scope: LinkedIn refused the permissions. Add both products (step 2), then sign in again.
res.signin.error.redirect: LinkedIn says the redirect address does not match. Make the address in step 3 match the portal exactly.
res.signin.error.client: LinkedIn did not accept the Client ID or Secret. Copy them again (step 4).
res.signin.error.timeout: The browser did not answer in time. Press Sign in to try again, or run 'profile-wrap auth --paste-redirect' in a terminal.
reauth.title: Sign in again by
reauth.text: Your sign-in lasts about 60 days and LinkedIn gives no refresh. Sign in again by {date}. The doctor and the board warn from {warn}.
reauth.none: A sign-in lasts about 60 days and LinkedIn gives no refresh. After you sign in, the exact date shows here.
api.title: Post through the API (optional)
api.text: Turning this on lets the review board post for you after you press Allow. You still approve every post. Unattended scheduled posting stays off.
api.done: API posting is on (api_click). You still press Allow before anything is posted.
api.needs_signin: Finish the five steps and sign in first.
api.refused.token: Sign in first. API posting needs a valid sign-in.
cli.enable_prompt: Turn on API posting now (click mode: you still press Allow before every post)? [y/N]
cli.press_enter: Press Enter when this is done (or q to stop):
cli.stopped: Stopped. Run 'profile-wrap auth connect' to continue.
cli.needs_tty: this guided setup needs a terminal. Open one and run it there, or use the Connect LinkedIn screen in the app.
